d:
Hogi dher saari baatein aur har koi batayega Tripling se juda apna anokha kissa,
Iss fan meet ke saath ab aap bhi baniye 10 saal se chal rahi iss special journey ka hissa!
A decade ago, three siblings set out on a road trip that became a journey we all found a little too relatable. To celebrate 10 years of Tripling, we brought the Tripling family and its amazing fans together for a special 10th Anniversary Fan Meet & Reunion!
